title: Suggested task from a plan gap — marked, and never a duplicate of what is open
setup: sp_goa_dec, trip 18-21 Dec, six weeks out. Plan: ["book flights CCU-GOI", "lock the stay", "airport cab both ways"]. Open tasks: exactly one — "Book flights CCU-GOI" (explicit, owner self). Nothing is open for the stay, and there has been no stay activity for four days; the three villas shortlisted last week are all still on free cancellation till Dec 1. The decide pass runs BECAUSE something changed (V6 P1 runs it on change, never on a clock): Rohan has just confirmed the flights are booked.
input_events: Rohan, Goa gang group: "flights ho gaye — 6E-334, 18 dec 7am CCU, PNR sabko bhej diya"
expected: The flights step is done, so the plan's next uncovered step is the stay — and a task exists for it (resume the villa shortlist), typed/origin `suggested`, carrying its evidence: the plan gap plus the date pressure. It is NOT capped: V6 P1 removed both suggested-task budgets, so if the cab step needs one too it exists as well. Every plan-gap task is marked `suggested`, never dressed as explicit or implicit. Nothing NEW is created for "Book flights CCU-GOI" — that title is already open, and the writer skips a repeat of an open title; the right move for it is a closure, not a second task.

wrong.label: unmarked-suggestion
wrong.assert_absent: a plan-gap task typed explicit or implicit — a suggestion the user cannot tell apart from something they actually said

wrong.label: no-suggestion
wrong.assert_absent: the stay step left with nothing at all — the plan's only uncovered step and the pass says nothing about it

wrong.label: evidence-free-suggestion
wrong.assert_absent: a suggested task with no evidence — no plan gap named and no date pressure quoted

source.section: TSK-03 · Suggested task from plan gap (re-authored V6 P1 R3 — the V1 case asserted "capped and marked" on a 2/day suggestion budget that Product §11.12.3 removes and build S5.2 deleted, so its `wrong[]` could not be violated by any shipped behaviour; and its trigger was a quiet clock tick, which V6 P1 does not make a call on. The marking half is kept, the cap half is replaced by the dedupe that actually ships, and the trigger is the change that queues Decide)
